children: The probability of the Charlotte Hornets defeating the Atlanta Hawks in an NBA regular-season prediction event on predict.fun was listed at 52%. According to Odaily, the teams were playing in the second quarter of their 2026-2027 season game, which also counts toward NBA Cup group play, with the visiting Hornets leading 46-36. The game began at 8 a.m. today.

Before the game, Atlanta ranked fifth in the Eastern Conference with a 9-6 record and was on a two-game winning streak after beating the Oklahoma City Thunder 117-112. Charlotte was 4-10 and 12th in the conference, had lost three straight, and had won once in its previous 10 games.
In the teams’ first meeting this season, Atlanta beat Charlotte 128-81, a 47-point margin. In NBA Cup group play, Atlanta was 1-1 and Charlotte was 0-2.

title: predict.fun Lists Hornets’ NBA Road Win Probability Against Hawks at 52%
